# Plugin host API

These are the supported core APIs an external plugin may call. Anything not listed is internal.

## Application context

### `Current`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Request-local access to the authenticated user and API user for plugin handlers. All other current attributes are internal and plugins must not assign these accessors.

- Supported class members: `api_user`, `user`

### `Syrus::Metrics`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Non-blocking metrics facade for plugin-declared counters, gauges, and histograms. Plugins may fetch declared instruments; registry mutation and core metric declarations are not public.

- Supported class members: `counter`, `gauge`, `histogram`

## Controllers

### `Api::V1::Admin::BaseController`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Base controller for plugin-owned administrative API routes. Subclasses may use inherited authentication, params, render, and policy helpers; filters and implementation details are not promised.

- Supported instance members: `params`, `render`

### `Api::V1::App::Admin::BaseController`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Base controller for authenticated plugin routes in the app admin namespace. Only inherited request, rendering, and authorization behavior is supported.

- Supported instance members: `params`, `render`

### `Api::V1::App::BaseController`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Base controller for authenticated plugin routes mounted in the application API. Only inherited request, rendering, and authorization behavior is supported.

- Supported instance members: `params`, `render`

## Execution

### `AgentInvocation::Result`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Result value returned by plugin agent and chat provider invocations. Construction and the listed outcome, transcript, usage, process, and success readers are supported; invocation engine internals are not.

- Supported class members: `new`
- Supported instance members: `aliveness_failed`, `cache_creation_input_tokens`, `cache_read_input_tokens`, `cost_usd`, `exit_status`, `final_text`, `input_tokens`, `is_error`, `operator_killed`, `outcome`, `output_tokens`, `process_outcome`, `session_id`, `silent_timed_out`, `spawned_process_id`, `stopped`, `success?`, `timed_out`, `transcript_jsonl`, `transcript_path`, `turns`

### `ProcessRunner`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Managed subprocess runner for plugin commands with host cancellation, timeout, confinement, and attribution. Plugins may use new, run, capture, start, mounts, and forwarded_env; backend and process-record internals are not public.

- Supported class members: `forwarded_env`, `mounts`, `new`
- Supported instance members: `capture`, `run`, `start`

## Jobs

### `ApplicationJob`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Base class for plugin-owned Active Job classes and the host operational-log context hook. Core queue topology and execution callbacks are not public.

- Supported class members: `queue_as`
- Supported instance members: `operational_log_context`

## Logging

### `OperationalLogging`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Structured operational event sink for plugin diagnostics. Plugins may emit bounded events through ingest; subscriber installation and storage internals are not public.

- Supported class members: `ingest`

### `PerformanceLogging`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Performance instrumentation helper for timing plugin work through named phases. Event storage, thresholds, and request instrumentation are not public.

- Supported class members: `phase`

## Plugin framework

### `Syrus::Plugin::AdminPage`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Marker contract for providers contributing administrative SPA pages through admin_pages metadata. Core navigation and route rendering internals are not public.

### `Syrus::Plugin::AgentProvider`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Interface mixed into registered agent providers, including model catalog and configuration hooks documented by the module. Provider orchestration and evidence internals are not public.

- Supported class members: `available_models`, `configured_for_user?`

### `Syrus::Plugin::Callbacks`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Lifecycle callbacks for registered plugin providers and cleanup effects. Plugins may implement the documented on_boot, on_shutdown, on_enable, on_disable, on_tick, and on_metrics_scrape callbacks.

- Supported instance members: `effect`, `on_boot`, `on_disable`, `on_enable`, `on_metrics_scrape`, `on_shutdown`, `on_tick`

### `Syrus::Plugin::ChatMcpToolSet`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Marker contract for chat MCP tool sets implementing tool_definitions, available_for?, and handle as documented by the interface. Core tool policy implementation is not public.

### `Syrus::Plugin::ChatProvider`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Marker contract for interactive chat providers implementing the documented provider metadata, constructor, and invoke interface. Host session orchestration is not public.

### `Syrus::Plugin::CliCommandHandler`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Base class for server-backed plugin CLI commands. Subclasses implement call and return values built with table, text, raw_text, or json; transport internals are not public.

- Supported class members: `json`, `raw_text`, `table`, `text`
- Supported instance members: `call`

### `Syrus::Plugin::DomainSubscriber`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Marker contract for providers declaring domain-event subscriptions and handlers. Delivery scheduling and core event persistence are not public.

### `Syrus::Plugin::GatedToolSet`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Shared implementation for plugin tool sets gated by plugin availability and coworker grants. Only the documented declaration, definition, lookup, availability, and handle methods are supported.

- Supported class members: `available_for_context?`, `find_tool_class`, `gated?`, `gated_by`, `tool_definitions`
- Supported instance members: `handle`

### `Syrus::Plugin::InputSource`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Marker contract for plugin input-source classes implementing poll!, validate_credentials!, config_schema, and dedup_key. Host polling internals are not public.

### `Syrus::Plugin::McpToolSet`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Marker contract for workflow MCP tool sets implementing tool_definitions, available_for?, and handle as documented by the interface. Core tool implementations are not public.

### `Syrus::Plugin::PermissionProvider`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Declaration contract for plugin capabilities, resource scopes, presets, authorization adapters, migrations, and retired identifiers. Core permission evaluation and storage are not public.

- Supported class members: `migrate_permission_scope`, `register_authorization_adapter`, `register_capability`, `register_permission_preset`, `register_resource_scope`, `retire_permission_identifier`

### `Syrus::Plugin::RepoPageTab`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Marker contract for providers contributing repository tabs through repo_page_tabs metadata scoped to a repository and user. Host navigation internals are not public.

### `Syrus::Plugin::RepositoryContentProvider`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Interface for immutable repository-content providers, including provider metadata and the documented resolve, tree, read, changes, refs, relation, history, commits, tree_sha, and divergence operations. Cache and fallback orchestration are not public.

- Supported class members: `available_for?`, `build`, `display_name`, `provider_key`, `role`
- Supported instance members: `changes`, `commits`, `divergence`, `history`, `read`, `refs`, `relation`, `resolve`, `tree`, `tree_sha`

### `Syrus::Plugin::SidebarPage`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Marker contract for providers contributing sidebar pages through sidebar_pages metadata. Host navigation rendering and polling internals are not public.

### `Syrus::Plugin::UiSlot`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Interface for panels contributed to named host UI slots through ui_slots metadata. Plugins may rely on SLOTS and valid_slot?; page rendering internals are not public.

- Supported class members: `valid_slot?`

### `Syrus::Plugin::WorkflowKinds`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Marker contract for providers contributing trigger, step, job, and work-definition entries through the documented optional methods. Registry compilation and dispatch internals are not public.

### `Syrus::PluginApi`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Primary plugin manifest DSL for declaring a plugin and installing its definition. Plugins may call syrus_plugin, syrus_plugin_definition, register!, enabled?, and default_version; Definition internals are not public.

- Supported class members: `default_version`

### `Syrus::PluginRegistry`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Registry boundary for plugin manifests and extension-point providers. Plugins may register manifests and query providers for declared extension points; mutation, reset, health, and cache internals are not public.

## Records

### `ApplicationRecord`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Active Record base for plugin-owned models using the Syrus primary database. Database internals and private core helpers are not promised.

- Supported class members: `belongs_to`, `has_many`

### `ChatSession`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Read access to a chat's identity, title, owner, repository, and messages. Turn orchestration, broadcasts, artifacts, and mutation helpers are not public.

- Supported instance members: `id`, `messages`, `repository`, `title`, `user`

### `Job`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Read access to a work item's identity, state, title, repository, owner, and workflows, plus visibility-scoped queries. State transitions, callbacks, and unlisted persistence APIs are not public.

- Supported class members: `accessible_to`, `visible_to`
- Supported instance members: `id`, `repository`, `state`, `title`, `user`, `workflows`

### `Repository`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Read access to repository identity, owner/name, archival state, and jobs, with active and user-scoped readable/writable queries. Credential fields, synchronization internals, callbacks, and unlisted mutations are not public.

- Supported class members: `accessible_to`, `active`, `writable_by`
- Supported instance members: `archived_at`, `id`, `jobs`, `name`, `owner`

### `Run`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Read access to an execution attempt's identity, state, step, workflow, and job. Dispatch, lifecycle transitions, agent metadata mutation, and unlisted associations are not public.

- Supported instance members: `id`, `job`, `state`, `step`, `workflow`

### `User`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Read access to user identity, handle, display name, administrator status, repositories, and jobs. Credentials, preferences, callbacks, and unlisted persistence methods are not public.

- Supported instance members: `admin?`, `display_name`, `handle`, `id`, `jobs`, `repositories`

### `Workflow`

Tier: `public`. Since Syrus 0.1.16. Read access to a workflow attempt's identity, state, owning job, steps, and runs. Scheduling, transitions, repair behavior, and unlisted mutations are not public.

- Supported instance members: `id`, `job`, `runs`, `state`, `steps`
